summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for requested Looma flows. Backend regression is stable (74/74 pass including iter5 feature tests). UI flows for auth, channels, remix, edit load, analytics, studio brand/comments/share/password, and PublicViewer password gate were exercised against production preview URL with real API calls.

ui_bugs.issue: Interactive 'Copy RSS feed URL' button lacks data-testid, reducing testability reliability requirement coverage.
Resolve/Delete/timestamp interaction buttons lack dedicated data-testid attributes though they are key interactions.

integration_issues.flow: Studio/PublicViewer playback for externally hosted URLs
integration_issues.issue: Browser console shows CORS errors when seeded videos use example.com URL; player shell renders and feature flows continue, but media stream is blocked by remote host CORS policy.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes for all Studio Share and CommentsPanel interactive controls to satisfy testability standard.
For playback validation scenarios, use storage-hosted/internal video URLs (or CORS-allowed assets) instead of example.com to avoid false media failures in browser.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with at least one maintained QA account pattern or policy; currently empty.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/backend_test.py still hardcodes fallback BASE_URL default ('https://media-craft-68.preview.emergentagent.com'); this violates env-only URL policy and can mask misconfiguration in future runs.

AuthContext authHeader() now returns empty object while many callers still pass headers: authHeader(); currently okay because cookie auth is primary, but this split path can cause confusion and brittle test assumptions. Consider centralizing on cookie-only call style in consumers.

CSRFMiddleware intentionally bypasses CSRF when cookie/header are absent but cookie auth exists; behavior is compatible with legacy clients, but document this clearly because strict double-submit is only enforced when both token sources are present.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows functionally passed; minor testability gaps + external media CORS noise)

test_credentials: REQUIRED CHECK FAILED: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no usable credentials. Testing used freshly created user via /api/auth/register per request.
seed_data_creation: Created one iter6 account and three test videos (main/aux/protected), plus one channel and one transient comment through UI/API during run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used: https://bold-goldstine-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Full backend suite passes with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set. UI automation validated requested flows end-to-end and produced screenshots + console log in /app/test_reports/pytest and /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260531_033100/.
rca of the issue: No business-logic regressions reproduced. Observed frontend issues are primarily testability compliance (missing data-testid on some interactive controls). Playback console errors were due to external test media host CORS policy (example.com), not Looma API/player business logic.
